encoder: UPMC-only Mammo-CLIP EfficientNet B5; frozen eval mode
pooling: C5 stride-32 valid-area-weighted average, including fractional boundary cells
precision: BF16 encoder convolution; FP32 pooling/cache; FP64 head fitting/scoring
head: StandardScaler + weighted binary logistic regression with L2 penalty; unpenalized intercept
class_weight: negative/positive ratio computed only from each fit fold; no oversampling
selection: Mean held-fold negative rejection at empirical 100% image sensitivity; then mean average precision; then smaller C
primary_operating_point: minimum positive validation logit, inclusive >=; preserves all observed validation positives
threshold_scope: Select once on the cleaned development validation subset; no OOF threshold transfer and no official-test scoring
test: Retained manifest only; no feature extraction, model selection, or evaluation in this run
